title: Kayeli language — Grokipedia
text: Kayeli is an Austronesian language belonging to the Malayo-Polynesian branch. [1][2] Within the Malayo-Polynesian group, it is classified under the Central-Eastern Malayo-Polynesian subgroup, specifically in the East Central Maluku branch, among the Seram languages, and as part of the Nunusaku subgroup.
